title: System Ignition
summary: Execute your first automation script to verify system readiness.
description: The Foundry's automation core is dormant. You must initialize the system by executing a Python script that outputs the canonical ignition sequence. This verifies your runtime environment is correctly configured.
lore: Welcome, Architect. The Foundry has been offline for generations. To begin the restoration, we need a clean handshake with the script execution engine. Print the ignition sequence exactly as specified to bridge the physical and logic layers.

title: Configurable Logic
summary: Use variables and conditions to report system pressure states.
description: A script must read a simulated pressure value from a variable and output a status report. If the pressure is above 80, output 'WARNING: HIGH PRESSURE'. Otherwise, output 'STATUS: STABLE'.

title: Batch Record Processing
short_description: Process a list of assembly line records.
summary: Iterate over a list of part IDs and filter the defective ones.
description: A batch of parts is coming down the line. Each part has a serial number. Defective parts have serial numbers starting with 'DEF-'. Write a script that loops through the list and prints only the valid serial numbers.
lore: The assembly line is producing anomalies. We can't let defective units reach the shipping crates. Automate the filter protocol.

title: Modular Helpers
short_description: Break down logic into reusable functions.
summary: Implement a helper to calculate tax and a main function to format results.
description: The accounting system is monolithic. Extract the tax calculation into a separate helper function to improve maintainability. Use a fixed tax rate of 0.08.
lore: The Ledger Bot is overheating. Its logic is one giant tangle of gears. Help us modularize the calc-flow so we can swap parts without breaking the whole Foundry.

title: Record Mapping
short_description: Map and transform data using dictionaries.
summary: Convert a list of raw records into a dictionary keyed by ID.
description: We have a list of system events. To make them searchable, we need to convert them into a dictionary where the key is the event 'id' and the value is the entire event object.
lore: Searching the linear log files is too slow. The Archivist needs a faster bridge between IDs and event data. Construct the map.

title: File Collector
summary: Read a text file containing part counts and calculate the total sum.
description: A manifest file contains one number per line. Read the file and output the total sum of all parts in the manifest.
lore: The clipboard bot lost its tally. We need you to read the raw manifest from the workspace and find the sum total. Accuracy is critical for the Foundry's quota.

title: Graceful Failure
short_description: Implement exception handling for robust scripts.
summary: Catch a division by zero error and log a custom message.
description: The workload balancer sometimes receives a zero divisor. Implement a try/except block to catch `ZeroDivisionError` and print 'ERROR: DIVISOR_ZERO'. Otherwise, print the result.
lore: The balancer crashed and took out Sector 7. We can't let a single zero divisor shut down the Foundry. Build the safety cage.
